Load necessary libraries
```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(Biobase)
library(limma)
library(affy)
library(R.utils)
library(dplyr)
library(sva)
library(plotly)
library(tibble)
```

Download metadata full series.matrix file
```{r}
#Study 1
gse<-getGEO('GSE71331')
gse<-gse[[1]]
phenotype_data<-pData(gse)
geo_accession<- "GSE71331"
```
Download the datasets that once untarred, will reveal the individual txt/CEL files (the raw data we want to use for analysis)
```{r}
gse_dir <- "<original_archive>/MICROARRAY_DATA/GSE71331"
output_dir<-"<original_archive>/MICROARRAY_DATA/GSE71331/txt_files"
```
Update phenotype conditions: clearly state "control" or "RIF"
- "patients:ch1" is the column where the conditions are stated; check this to ensure it aligns with pheno column name
```{r}
phenotype_data <- phenotype_data %>%
  mutate(`characteristics_ch1` = case_when(
    grepl("Control", `patients:ch1`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Control",
    grepl("failure", `patients:ch1`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RIF",
    TRUE ~ title #(Keep original value if neither is matched)
  ))
phenotype_data <- phenotype_data %>%
  rename(condition = characteristics_ch1)

#write.csv(phenotype_data, file = "phenotype_data_GSE71331.csv", row.names = TRUE)

```

Read the raw data
```{r}
#Reload the txt files
txt_files <- list.files(output_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
raw_data <- read.maimages(txt_files, source="agilent", green.only = TRUE)
```
Background correction
```{r}
bg_corrected_data <- backgroundCorrect(raw_data, method="normexp")
```
Normalization
```{r}
norm_data <-normalizeBetweenArrays(bg_corrected_data, method = "quantile")
norm_data$E<- log2(norm_data$E + 1)

```

data check: density plots
```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=9}
# Density plot for raw data (before normalization)
plot(density(bg_corrected_data$E[, 1]), 
     main = "Density Plot: Before Normalization", 
     xlab = "Expression Intensity", 
     col = 1, lwd = 2)
for (i in 2:ncol(bg_corrected_data$E)) {
  lines(density(bg_corrected_data$E[, i]), col = i, lwd = 2)
}
legend("topright", legend = colnames(bg_corrected_data$E), col = 1:ncol(bg_corrected_data$E), lwd = 2, cex = 0.2)

# Density plot for normalized data
plot(density(norm_data$E[, 1]), 
     main = "Density Plot: After Normalization", 
     xlab = "Expression Intensity", 
     col = 1, lwd = 2)
for (i in 2:ncol(norm_data$E)) {
  lines(density(norm_data$E[, i]), col = i, lwd = 2)
}
legend("topright", legend = colnames(norm_data$E), col = 1:ncol(norm_data$E), lwd = 1, cex = 0.5)

```

data check: box plots
```{r}
# Box plot for raw data (before normalization)
boxplot(bg_corrected_data$E, main = "Before Normalization", las = 2)
boxplot(norm_data$E, main = "After Normalization", las = 2)
```

```{r}
# Perform PCA on normalized data
pca <- prcomp(t(norm_data$E), scale. = TRUE)  # Transpose so samples are rows and genes are columns

# Create a PCA data frame for plotting
pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$x[, 1],  # First principal component
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2],  # Second principal component
  Condition = phenotype_data$condition  # Add condition information from phenotype_data
)

# Plot PCA with ggplot2
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("PCA: Clustering by Condition") +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca)$importance[2, 1] * 100, 2), "% variance)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca)$importance[2, 2] * 100, 2), "% variance)"))


```
3D plot
```{r}

# Perform PCA 
pca <- prcomp(t(norm_data$E), scale. = TRUE)
pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
  PC3 = pca$x[, 3],
  Condition = phenotype_data$condition
)
fig <- plot_ly(
  data = pca_df,
  x = ~PC1, 
  y = ~PC2, 
  z = ~PC3,
  color = ~Condition,
  colors = c("red", "blue"),
  marker = list(size = 5),
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers"
)

#layout details
fig <- fig %>%
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca)$importance[2, 1] * 100, 2), "%)")),
      yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca)$importance[2, 2] * 100, 2), "%)")),
      zaxis = list(title = paste0("PC3 (", round(summary(pca)$importance[2, 3] * 100, 2), "%)"))
    )
  )
fig
```

Annotation
Download 
```{r}
# Define the file path (update this to your local file path)
file_path <- "<original_archive>/MICROARRAY_DATA/GSE71331/GSE71331_annotation.txt"

# Read the file into R as a data frame
platform_data <- read.delim(file_path, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Remove rows with missing or blank gene symbols
platform_data <- platform_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(GeneSymbol) & GeneSymbol != "")

```

Prep DF for annotation (take expression data and align with ProbeUID)
```{r}
#Convert the expression matrix to a data frame and add ProbeUID from norm_data$genes
expr_df <- as.data.frame(norm_data$E)
if(nrow(expr_df) != nrow(norm_data$genes)) {
  stop("Mismatch: The number of rows in norm_data$E does not match the number of entries in norm_data$genes.")
}
expr_df$ProbeUID <- norm_data$genes$ProbeUID

#Ensure that the IDs in both datasets are characters for proper comparison
expr_df$ProbeUID <- as.character(expr_df$ProbeUID)
platform_data$ProbeID <- as.character(platform_data$ProbeID)

# Find overlapping ProbeIDs
common_ids <- intersect(expr_df$ProbeUID, platform_data$ProbeID)
cat("Number of overlapping IDs:", length(common_ids), "\n")

#filter the aggregated expression data to include only overlapping probes
expr_common <- expr_df %>% filter(ProbeUID %in% common_ids)

#Code below assumes your aggregated data frame has the first column named "ProbeUID" and all other columns correspond to sample files with long names
#move ProbeUID to be the first column
expr_common <- expr_common %>% select(ProbeUID, everything())

old_cols <- colnames(expr_common)
new_cols <- c( "ProbeUID", sapply(old_cols[-1], function(x) sub(".*(GSM\\d+).*", "\\1", x))
)
colnames(expr_common) <- new_cols

```

Create the final annotation file
```{r}
# Subset the platform annotation according to the common IDs
plat_sub <- platform_data %>%
  filter(ProbeID %in% common_ids)

# Merge into one new object
combined_annot <- inner_join(
  expr_common,
  plat_sub,
  by = c("ProbeUID" = "ProbeID")
)
```


```{r}

## 1) Grab just the expression columns (all numeric sample columns)
expr_mat <- combined_annot %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

## 2) Set rownames to GeneSymbol
gene_ids <- combined_annot$GeneSymbol
rownames(expr_mat) <- gene_ids

## 3) Collapse duplicate probes → one row per gene
expr71331 <- limma::avereps(expr_mat, ID = rownames(expr_mat))

## 4) Write gene × sample matrix
#write.csv(expr71331, "GSE71331_matrix_nov18.csv", row.names = TRUE)

```
